I'm not writing `skills/migration-dry-run/SKILL.md` yet. writing-skills says to read `discovery.md` before writing frontmatter or the body layout. It also says to read `claude-code.md`, since this skill will run in Claude Code, and `bulletproofing.md` and `persuasion-principles.md` before wording the counters. I'm also re-reading your baseline file so the rationalization table uses the agents' exact words.

This is a discipline skill. In 14 of 20 baseline runs, agents skipped the dry run under pressure, so I plan to write it like this:

- **Description:** starts with "Use when...", lists only triggers (applying a migration to staging, running migrate/upgrade commands, schema changes), and doesn't summarize the workflow.
- **Body:** a clear prohibition (no migration applied to staging without a dry run first), a rationalization table built from the baseline quotes ("staging is disposable", "only additive", "dry run takes too long"), and a red flags list.

Once I've read the references, I'll send you the draft.
